**Layer**: L2 storage hosting（graph BaaS + map / git / search）  
**As-of**: 2026-07-02  
**Prose 解説**: `90-docs/adr/2607021500-portfolio-seven-layer-business-model-lean-canvas.md`

## Problem

- graph DB の自前運用は重い
- pin/storage サービスに provenance がない
- map/git/search が別 SaaS に分散し data 主権が失われる
- 観測 (signal): kotobase.net 実測 3483 req/7d・272 uniques(日次和)、workers 5311 inv/7d

## Customer Segments

- 個人 engineer (Free)
- AI/app チーム (Standard/Pro)
- enterprise data チーム
- regulated (専有 tenant/read audit/key custody)

## Unique Value Proposition

- content-addressed KG 1 本の上に storage/graphdb/map/git/search が同居
- 1 commit CID で全 surface が再現可能・監査可能
- DB そのものが可搬 (WASM+CID+atproto) = lock-in の逆張り

## Solution

- kotobase.net 稼働済: pin (CAR-on-B2) / Datalog / SPARQL/Cypher 読み / KG ingest
- add-on surface: map tiles/geo query / git remote / search index

## Channels

- free self-serve → paid workspace (yatabase 型)
- OSS kotoba 開発者
- 全社内プロダクトが tenant

## Revenue Streams

- tier subscription Free/Standard/Pro/Regulated (docs/BUSINESS-MODEL.md が正)
- surface add-on 従量: map API / git seat / search query
- enterprise/regulated 契約

## Cost Structure

- B2
- CF Workers
- index 計算
- compliance 対応

## Key Metrics

- pinned CID 数
- active graphs
- query volume
- storage GB
- paid workspace 数
- add-on attach 率
- 次の検証 (kotobase-graph-arpu): Standard→Pro 転換率と add-on attach 率

## Unfair Advantage

- 全社 state (murakumo fleet/manimani ledger/itonami 台帳/aozora blob) が乗る内需 floor
- provenance 標準を握る

## Hypotheses

| id | risk | status | claim | gate | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `:hyp/kotobase-graph-arpu` | riskiest | untested | graph+provenance が pin 単品より高い ARPU を正当化する | Standard→Pro 転換率と add-on attach 率 | — |
